title: Gardens of the Moon
author: Steven Erikson
summary: The first Malazan Book of the Fallen. A vast empire is trying to take another free city while soldiers, mages and gods all pursue their own aims. The book drops you into a deep, long history without explaining it.
readIf: you want a dense, enormous fantasy world with soldiers' grit and are happy to piece things together yourself.
skipIf: you want clear exposition or a gentle on-ramp, because this opening book is famously demanding.

pairings.reason: A leaner war story from the ranks of a mercenary company, with the same grit and morally tangled loyalties.
Another giant, many-book epic with ancient magic, if you want a more accessible start to a big series.
Large-scale political fantasy with many viewpoints and an unforgiving tone, but tighter in focus.
